content.title: Insulet’s (NASDAQ:PODD) Q3: Strong Sales
content.summary: Insulin delivery company Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ:PODD) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 29.9% year on year to $706.3 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($767.8 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 5.1% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.24 per share was 8.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
